scope: Five reusable native app presentation entries only. Sample screens are development fixtures, not production coverage targets. All five remain validation pending.
implementationReview: NativeAlertModifier retains native alert fields/actions and app-owned bindings, validation, callbacks and roles.
NativeActivityView presents through an anchored popover, adapting to the native iPhone sheet; share items, activities and callbacks remain app-owned.
NativeContextMenuPreviewModifier preserves preview, disabled and destructive actions, nested menus and native adaptive placement.
NativePageSheetModifier represents the source large sheet with grabber and nested stacking; it is not a fullScreenCover.
No experimental input-alert adapter is included; existing public native APIs are preserved.

Actual system Dynamic Type measurement
checks.observed: Title height20.5->63.5pt and message18->116.5pt at largest accessibility setting. Native iPad field containers remain35pt. Original simulator setting restored.

coveredInteractions: Native alert zero/one/two fields, validation, single-activation save, cancel and destructive callbacks.
Context preview, disabled action, nested submenu and palette action callback/dismissal.
Stacked sheets preserve underlying content state and invoke presenter dismissal callback.
Share sheet/popover open and cancel in light/dark without sending.
Dark RTL alert and form automated audits: descriptions, traits, hit regions and clipping.
Native alert title responds to preferred accessibility content size.
limitations: iPhone real-HID driver failed its two-field assertion (name observed uppercase, secure field still empty); keyboard flow remains unresolved.
Manual VoiceOver, physical-device and minimum OS26 runtime validation remain pending; these simulator runs use27.2.
Full dark/RTL/large-text and anchor-placement matrices, interactive dismissal and long localized content remain pending.
Share destination activation, successful/error completion and real external sharing are not exercised.
Automated audits and preview captures do not establish exhaustive fidelity or assistive-technology behavior.
No Figma source links were saved or removed. React remains active; native activation is deferred.
initialFailures: XCTest named-key injection did not reliably dispatch Return/Escape; actual HID passed on iPad. Discarded unnecessary experimental UIKit adapter.

A field-height growth assertion failed because UIKit retains35pt iPad alert input rows. Corrected assertion measures native title text; actual system-size measurements independently confirm title/message scaling.
The concurrent iPad suite had one switch-state fixture failure. The final retry waits for the actual state change; both suite and retry summaries are retained.
